costs.chargedOn: full opening gross notional + full terminal liquidation for every event; total turnover=2.0 per event

dataAuthority.liquidity: trailing 30 calendar days quote volume from bars strictly before funding decision; mean >= USD 5m/day
dataAuthority.provider: Binance USD-M Futures public market data

failureRule: Development failure closes ARP15-FLR1 with validation and holdout sealed. Validation failure closes without holdout. Holdout failure forbids retuning. No R15 mutation unless all gates plus integration and final QA pass.

governance.cohortSelection: Binance USD-M exchangeInfo metadata only; current trading USDT perpetuals, onboarded by 2023-10-20 inclusive, zero overlap with V13 closedEvidence plus manually recovered Q6-G4 cohort; fixed first 20 by onboardDate/lexical among qualifying fresh symbols.

researchRationale.causalDistinctness: Not carry harvesting, not log-basis, not trailing-7d funding carry. Uses the just-realized raw funding level only as a cross-sectional price-continuation signal after the settlement is known.
externalDiscoveryOnly: Public 2026 research reports raw funding-level return predictability concentrated at short horizons and stronger from 2024 onward.
Execution is deliberately delayed one full hour after the funding print and exits one hour before a standard next 8h settlement, making this stricter than contemporaneous-settlement backtests.

signalContract.decisionEvent: actual realized funding event timestamp t; funding rate must be final and observable at t
signalContract.eventOverlap: none by construction for standard 8h schedules
signalContract.fundingCashflowInsideTrade: forbidden; symbol is ineligible for event t if any fundingTime occurs strictly after t and on/before t+7h
signalContract.holding: 6 hours; portfolio is flat from t+7h through the next standard t+8h funding boundary
signalContract.rankingSignal: raw realized fundingRate at t; descending signal means stronger continuation
signalContract.weights: +0.50 equally long / -0.50 equally short; gross 1.0, net 0
